events.title: A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET 1 (1984) & 2: Freddy's Revenge (1985)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Come out as we begin our NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET MARATHON in the next few weeks!!

Tonight we start with:

**8:00pm: A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET**
1984 - 1hr 31mins
Horror/Crime
Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in real life.

**9:30pm: A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET 2: FREDDY'S REVENGE**
1985 - 1hr 27mins
Horror/Crime
A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.

events.title: ALL HALLOW'S EVE DOUBLE FEATURE - The Birthday Girl and Witching & Bitching
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**It's ALL HALLOWS EVE!!** Let's watch a fun horror comedy double feature and then some more horror shorts if the group is still up and wanting to keep watching!

**8pm: THE BIRTHDAY GIRL**
2001 - 1hr 34mins
Thriller/Comedy
A thirtysomething bank clerk from St Albans has his small-town life exploded by the arrival of his Russian mail-order bride.

**9:30pm: WITCHING & BITCHING**
**(Las brujas de Zugarramurdi)**
2013 - 1hr 52mins
Horror/Comedy
**Language**: Spanish w/ English subtitles
A gang of armed robbers finds a safe haven in a secluded village crammed with witches--only to encounter the bizarre, the unexpected, and the occult. Can they save themselves, and the rest of the world from the next witch apocalypse?

events.title: HALLOWEEN HORROR MOVIE MARATHON!!
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**HAPPY HALLOWEEN!!**

Let's enjoy the horror group's favorite holiday and celebrate with a movie marathon from 12pm to 12pm (with a 90min dinner break)!!

**12pm**: **Manhunter -** 1986 ‧ Horror/Mystery - 2hrs
Former FBI profiler Will Graham returns to service to pursue a deranged serial killer dubbed "the Tooth Fairy" by the media.

**2pm:** **Boxing Helena -** 1993 ‧ Horror/Romance - 1hr45mins
A surgeon becomes obsessed with the seductive woman he once was in an affair with. Refusing to accept that she has moved on, he amputates her limbs and holds her captive in his mansion.

**3:45pm**: **House on Haunted Hill -** 1999 ‧ Horror/Supernatural - 1hr33mins
An amusement park mogul offers a group of diverse people $1,000,000 to spend the night in a haunted house with a horrifying past.

**7pm**: **Odd Thomas -** 2013 ‧ Horror/Mystery - 1hr40mins
In a California desert town, a short-order cook with clairvoyant abilities encounters a mysterious man with a link to dark, threatening forces.

**8:45pm: The Special -** 2020 ‧ Horror - 1hr 34mins
Suspecting his wife of infidelity, Jerry follows his friend down a dark rabbit hole into a horror landscape of addiction.

**10:15pm: Big Baby -** 2025 ‧ Horror - 1hr 45mins
Successful horror screenwriter Adam struggles for inspiration until a terrifying nightmare about a masked killer sparks an idea for his new script. As he delves deeper into the story, the line between reality and fiction begins to blur.
